name: Sterea Ellada
shape: Eurostat NUTS, the area it is named for

blurb.text: A Greek PGI where Savatiano is the main grape at about 63% of the vineyard area. Roditis follows at 17%, with small amounts of Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah and Merlot.
